## 简体中文

### 新增

- 新增 Windows 11 风格 Alt-Tab 切换器，支持可配置修饰键、最近使用窗口排序、按住循环切换和鼠标选择。
- 新增紧凑悬停控件，可对支持的窗口执行最小化、最大化或恢复以及关闭操作。

### 性能

- 立即显示缓存的窗口缩略图和亚克力内容，再在后台刷新截图与辅助功能能力。
- 在显示前构建当前切换器布局并禁用打开时缩放，避免缩略图摩尔纹和屏幕闪烁。

### 修复

- 根据窗口数量调整缩略图尺寸，让密集列表保持在五个完整行加一个溢出标题行内，并统一使用细滚动条。
- 排除任务栏后在可用区域内居中显示切换器，包括任务栏位于屏幕左右两侧时。
- 点击 Alt-Tab 外部时关闭面板且不切换窗口，同时保留悬停高亮、紧凑控件、边框和按压反馈。
- 窗口操作会尊重全屏状态和窗口几何；快捷键捕获改为独占；直接调用调度中心；打开设置时关闭开始菜单。

## English

### Added

- Added a Windows 11-style Alt-Tab switcher with configurable modifier keys, MRU window ordering, hold-to-cycle behavior, and mouse selection.
- Added compact hover controls for minimizing, maximizing or restoring, and closing supported windows.

### Performance

- Presented cached window thumbnails and acrylic content immediately, then refreshed captures and Accessibility capabilities in the background.
- Built the current switcher layout before presentation and disabled opening rescaling to prevent thumbnail moire and screen flicker.

### Fixed

- Adapted thumbnail size to the window count, kept dense lists within five full rows plus an overflow title row, and used a consistently thin scrollbar.
- Centered the switcher within the usable area after excluding the taskbar, including taskbars placed on either side of the screen.
- Dismissed Alt-Tab without switching windows when clicking outside it, while preserving hover highlighting, compact controls, borders, and pressed feedback.
- Respected fullscreen state and window geometry during window actions, made shortcut capture exclusive, invoked Mission Control directly, and closed Start when opening Settings.
